Healthcare statistician and data scientist specializing in bringing structure to complex analytical problems. I help healthcare leaders and organizations translate ambiguous clinical, research, and operational questions into reproducible analytical systems through thoughtful data design, statistical modeling, interactive applications, and reusable workflows.

## Professional Experience

\job{Cleveland Clinic}{Research Data Scientist II}{February 2023--Present}{Remote / Wausau, WI}

- Build statistical modeling frameworks and analysis plans for observational research studies, including clinical risk prediction, propensity score methods, survival analysis, and machine learning.
- Maintainer of, and contributor to, riskcalc.org, a repository of risk calculators for medical decision making.
- Created and administer a department GitHub organization for open-source development
- Integrated git-based workflows into statistical project management, version control, issue tracking, and collaborative development.
- Write SQL queries to extract and structure EHR data from data warehouse environments.
- Contribute statistical, methodological, and analytic sections to grant proposals and scientific manuscripts.
- Tools: R, SQL, Python, Shiny (Server), dbt, Snowflake, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Posit Workbench/Connect, Quarto, R Markdown, Epic, H20

\bigskip

\job{Aspirus Health}{Data Scientist}{November 2020--January 2023}{Wausau, WI}

- Designed ETL processes that centralized data from multiple sources into reusable analytics models for Vizient Clinical Database reporting, quality benchmarking, and operational insight.
- Built interactive R Shiny applications for quality improvement programs (readmissions, value-based purchasing, Leapfrog), enabling leaders to explore “what-if” scenarios, identify improvement opportunities, and assess financial impact.
- Developed reproducible R Markdown analyses and interactive data stories around clinical, operational, quality, and business metrics.
- Partnered with clinical, quality, and operational stakeholders to clarify metric definitions, reporting needs, data limitations, and decision context.
- Epic Cogito and Epic Caboodle Data Model certifications.
- Tools: R, SQL, Shiny, R Markdown, QlikSense, Epic

- Integrated producer activity text data into predictive models to improve prospect prioritization.
- Developed Tableau dashboards to evaluate geographic impacts of pricing models and underwriting issues.
- Wrote SQL queries in SAS to extract, transform, and prepare analysis datasets from enterprise data sources.
- Tools: R, Python, SAS, SQL, Tableau
